UPDATE transactions
                     SET date = ?, amount_minor = ?, status = ?, raw_description = ?,
                         dedupe_key = ?, last_seen_at = ?, pending_miss_count = 0,
                         updated_at = ?,
                         sync_flag = CASE WHEN ? THEN 'amount_changed_split' ELSE sync_flag END
                     WHERE id = ?
